CSCA Academic Chinese Syllabus & Formats/CSCA 学术中文大纲与测试模块

01

Reading Comprehension: Reading academic texts, scientific abstracts, historical essays; identifying paragraph arguments and core themes.

阅读理解：考查学术类长文章、科普短文及史料的阅读；要求精准提取段落大意、把握作者观点及逻辑脉络。

02

Grammar & Syntax: Finding common grammatical errors, word collocations, logical coherence in paragraph sequencing.

语法与结构：考查病句改错（成分残缺、搭配不当、语序混乱等）、词语搭配、语段衔接的逻辑连贯性。

03

Academic Vocabulary: High-frequency HSK 5 and HSK 6 professional vocabulary, idioms (Chengyu) in academic contexts, formal writing structures.

学术词汇：考查 HSK 5级和6级高频学术词汇、书面语表达方式、学术关联词的使用以及科技场景专业词汇。

04

Chinese Culture & Logic: Basic knowledge of traditional Chinese culture, logical reasoning written in Chinese.

传统文化与逻辑：考查中国基础国情与传统文化常识、中文语境下的简单逻辑推理。

CSCA Chinese Study Strategy/CSCA 中文如何高效备考与复习

Read Chinese academic summaries, abstracts, and science news to build vocabulary.

平时多阅读中文学术摘要、科普新闻，快速积累科学与教育领域的专业学术词汇。

Practice parsing long complex Chinese sentence structures to find subjects, verbs, and objects.

练习划分中文长难句结构，提炼句子的主谓宾骨架，以快速看懂复杂的长句子。

Use our pacer clock simulator to budget reading time: aim to read 300 characters per minute.

使用平台的配速时钟进行限时阅读训练：目标达到每分钟阅读300字并能准确答题。

Review HSK 5/6 vocab lists regularly, focusing on formal writing connectors (e.g. 进而, 从而, 鉴于).

定期梳理 HSK 5/6级高频词汇表，特别注意书面语关联词（如‘进而’、‘从而’、‘鉴于’）的用法。

Frequently Asked Questions

All you need to know about the CSCA assessment & prep

What HSK level corresponds to CSCA Chinese?CSCA 中文考试相当于 HSK 几级？expand_more

CSCA Chinese is designed to evaluate academic capability, roughly aligned with HSK level 5 to 6 vocabulary, but focused heavily on science and logical reading.

CSCA 中文考试旨在评估学生的学术汉语能力，其词汇量与 HSK 5-6级相当，但在考查内容上更偏向于科技、学术阅读与逻辑推理。

Is there a writing section in CSCA Chinese?CSCA 中文考试中包含写作吗？expand_more

No, the online portal test consists exclusively of multiple choice questions, although direct university admissions may request writing samples separately.

线上的 CSCA 评估测试完全为单项选择题，不包含主观写作题（不过部分高校在后续面试或复试中可能会要求单独提供写作样本）。

How to improve academic vocabulary fast?如何快速积累学术汉语词汇？expand_more

Use CSCA Space's HSK 5-6 academic drill system. We filter vocabulary words by frequency in STEM articles, helping you focus on the most high-yield words first.

推荐使用 CSCA Space 的 HSK 5-6 级学术汉语分类词汇训练系统。我们对 STEM 学术文章中的高频词汇进行了过滤整理，帮助您优先学习最核心的词汇。

mainEntity.name: What is the CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) is the standardized STEM competency assessment used by top Chinese universities and CSC Government Scholarship committees to evaluate international undergraduate candidates in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: How to prepare for the CSCA exam online?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for the CSCA exam, students should use CSCA Space (csca.space) for adaptive mock test simulations, past paper questions, bilingual terminology drills, formula sheets, and step-by-step video explainers aligned with the official CSCA syllabus.

mainEntity.name: What subjects are tested in the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA exam tests four core disciplines: Mathematics (Algebra, Calculus, Analytical Geometry), Physics (Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Waves), Chemistry (Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Stoichiometry), and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find CSCA past papers and practice questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides verified CSCA mock exams, diagnostic assessments, and curated past questions with comprehensive step-by-step pedagogical walkthroughs at https://csca.space.

mainEntity.name: How does CSCA Space help international students prepare for the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides 100% syllabus-aligned interactive practice, bilingual English and Chinese STEM explanations, full diagnostic scoring, and adaptive mock test simulations designed specifically for international university admissions in China.

mainEntity.name: What is a competitive score on the CSCA for CSC scholarships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidates scoring in the 80th percentile and above are highly competitive for full Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A & Type B) and direct admission into top C9 league universities.
